_comment: Nova backend configuration. Edit freely. Ports differ from Jarvis (3000/8765) so both can run simultaneously.

llm._note: For higher quality at ~2x latency, swap to mlx-community/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct-4bit. n_ctx is fixed at 4096 — do not raise without testing.

tts._note: stream_while_generating: speak each sentence as the LLM produces it (Nova starts talking on sentence 1). If playback ever starves/crackles, set false to fall back to generate-fully-then-speak. post_utterance_delay_s: settle time before the mic re-opens so Nova doesn't hear its own tail.

wake_word._note: engine: 'transcript' (legacy Whisper scan) or 'openwakeword' (neural, noise-robust). Stays 'transcript' until the trained nova.onnx is validated, then flip to 'openwakeword'. oww_* tune the neural detector: threshold=per-window score to count as a hit, trigger_level=consecutive hits to fire, vad_threshold=Silero speech gate (0 disables). After Nova replies it stays in conversation mode (no wake word) until conversation_timeout_s of silence.

user.name: Nicholas
user._note: Change address_as to 'sir' or any preferred form of address.

calendar._note: Reads are always summarized by the LLM (natural voice, with a deterministic template fallback). natural_confirmations=true also runs create/reminder confirmations through the LLM (~4-6s slower); false uses fast deterministic templates.
